verdicts.reason: A breaks up the flavour pills: Cucumber Mint sits alone at the top over the decorative circle, Blood Orange is stuck at the left edge, and Honey Rosemary floats at the bottom. The SOLSTICE wordmark is blown up and placed under the headline, so the brand competes with the message. B keeps the pills together in one stack above the CTA, but their widths are uneven (Honey Rosemary is far too wide). The left-aligned headline and copy sit tight against the edge while the pills and button are centred, the text block is cramped and the wordmark is still below the headline. Both are flawed, but B is the more coherent of the two.
